line: Offer your phone charger to a stranger in need.
paragraph: On October 5, a cheetah named Zura at the Smithsonian's Conservation Institute in Virginia gave birth to five cubs. The institute set up a live webcam inside her den, so anyone can watch her tend to them at any hour. The sound picks up soft chirps and tiny purrs between mother and newborns. A stranger in a waiting room with a dying phone might notice you pull out your charger. You hand it over, and they call their ride home. The cubs are there to check in on later, round and sleepy and new.
